title: [bundle] Fix remaining unsupported-flag fail-open gaps on side-effect
objective: Fix remaining unsupported-flag fail-open gaps on side-effecting hf commands. Commands such as hf plan --unknown and hf handoff --unknown currently ignore unsupported args and write files, while hf reconcile and hf sync-cards also ignore unknown args. Make these side-effecting/no-arg commands reject unsupported arguments before mutation with clear diagnostics, add regressions proving no files are written on unsupported flags, and keep documented help paths working.
acceptance_criteria: hf plan, hf handoff, hf reconcile, and hf sync-cards reject unsupported arguments before side effects.
Unsupported-argument regressions prove those commands exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo.
Documented help paths for the affected commands still exit 0.
Normal supported plan/handoff/reconcile/sync-cards behavior is not otherwise downgraded.
